answer: Ferrous Bond Vault: an agent locks 5,000 POA for 90 days to mint one Relic identity key, and the Dune escrow holds the bond until the key completes 8 attested tasks. A duplicate key triggers a slash that burns the whole bond and blacklists the vault. Forging 500 fake identities locks 2.5 million POA for three months and risks burning it all, while one honest agent pays a single bond once and reuses its Relic key forever.
